scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @amethyst/api" "npm run dev -w @amethyst/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @amethyst/protocol && npm run build -w @amethyst/api && npm run build -w @amethyst/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @amethyst/protocol && npm run typecheck -w @amethyst/api && npm run typecheck -w @amethyst/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @amethyst/api && npm run test -w @amethyst/web
